property_summary: For any filled order, once the owner of a position NFT transfers it to a new owner, that new owner must still be able to transfer it again (the ownership record persists and only the per-token approval is cleared); the mutant deletes _ownerOf instead of getApproved, so the recipient is no longer recognized as the owner and any subsequent transfer reverts.
change_summary: Replace `delete getApproved[id];` with `delete _ownerOf[id];`, wiping the ownership record instead of the approval after transfer.
